issue: Source PDF error: in the 2014 energy balance three row labels are shifted. The rows printed as 'East Kalimantan', 'N, C Sulawesi & Gorontalo' and 'East Kalimantan' hold the figures of S & C Kalimantan, East Kalimantan and N, C Sulawesi respectively. Confirmed by matching own production and purchases with Table 23 (e.g. 3210.12 GWh = S & C Kalimantan).
action_taken: Relabelled by row position (config relabel_rows). Corrected after the first 2014–2025 delivery, which carried the printed labels.

issue: Source PDF error: in the 2022 energy balance the three generation-subsidiary labels are rotated. 37,510 GWh is printed against 'PJB Sulawesi', a 68 MW unit in Tables 1/21. In row order the values belong to PT Indonesia Power, PT PJB and PJB Sulawesi, which matches Table 23 exactly.
action_taken: Relabelled by row position (config relabel_rows). Corrected after the first delivery.

issue: Source PDF inconsistency: Table 2 and Table 23 assign the two Kalimantan subsidiaries' generation the other way round (2,971 vs 3,675 GWh). Table 23's plant-type mix matches Table 21's capacities (only Indonesia Power Kalimantan has combined-cycle plant), so Table 2's labels are taken to be swapped.
action_taken: Table 2 rows relabelled (config relabel_rows). Corrected after the first delivery.

issue: Definition: in 2017–2018 Table 2 'own production' excludes leased plants (it equals Table 23's own generation without leased). In 2014–2016 it includes them. From 2019 leased plants have their own column in Table 2.
action_taken: Kept as published. For a consistent series use Table 23 (own_* and leased_* columns).

issue: Definition change: in the 2014 and 2015 reports Table 1 installed capacity covers PLN-owned plants only (it equals the Table 21 PLN-owned subtotal). From 2016 it includes leased and IPP plants. National installed capacity therefore jumps from 40.3 GW (2015) to 54.7 GW (2016).
action_taken: Kept as published. For a consistent capacity trend use t21 total_mw (all ownership types, every year) or t21 pln_owned_subtotal_mw.

issue: Definition break: national SAIDI/SAIFI jump from 5.3 h / 6.0 times (2015) to 25.5 h / 15.1 times (2016), which reflects a change in how PLN counts interruptions rather than a fivefold deterioration.
action_taken: Kept as published. Start reliability trend charts in 2016, or footnote the break.

issue: The 2016 Java-Bali system peak (UIP2B 33107 MW) is far above 2015 (about 24000 MW) and 2017 (25665 MW), so national peak load spikes in 2016 only.
action_taken: Kept as published. Treat 2016 peak load as anomalous.

issue: Distribution line lengths fluctuate in the early reports (e.g. low-voltage lines 585754 kms in 2014, 527494 in 2016, 626720 in 2017, 564506 in 2018), which suggests inventory recounts.
action_taken: Kept as published. Smooth trends look reliable from 2018.

issue: Source inconsistency: the Java unit rows sum to 27818.19 MW, but the published Java total is 31062.19 MW (3244 MW unexplained). Table 21's Java figures reconcile.
action_taken: Kept as published.

issue: The right-hand page of Table 23 is blank for 'Generation Unit of Java Bali' (no subtotal or total), although its 40927 GWh of own generation is included in the Java total.
action_taken: Kept as published (empty). Use the own_* columns for this row.

issue: Source inconsistency: the South and West Sulawesi province rows' leased values don't match their subtotals (a 15 GWh difference). The regional row is consistent.
action_taken: Kept as published. Use the UIW row.

issue: Source PDF error: the regional 150 kV value (821.85) doesn't match its provinces (1243.78). The published total (1621.56) matches the provinces.
action_taken: Kept as published. Use the province rows or total_kms.

issue: These three tables print Indonesian and English unit names on top of each other.
action_taken: Read the English layer only. Values are unaffected.

issue: Several rows of the 2015 report (names and numbers) use a shifted font encoding.
action_taken: Decoded automatically. All totals reconcile.

issue: Small source rounding differences (3 GWh; 1 MVA).
action_taken: Kept as published.

issue: Source PDF error: in 2017 the 'subtotal %' column repeats each unit's leased MW value (e.g. Aceh 47.00 = leased 47.00). Only the Indonesia row (100.00) is meaningful.
action_taken: Set to empty for all unit rows in 2017.

issue: Before 2018, gas engines (PLTMG), mini/micro hydro and biomass are not reported separately in Table 21; Table 23 separates gas engines ('Diesel Gas') but not mini/micro hydro. Wind appears in Table 23 from 2015.
action_taken: Missing columns are left empty; see years_available.

issue: P3B Jawa Bali (transmission plus load dispatch) existed until 2015. From 2016 it is reported as UIP2B (dispatch) plus three UITs (transmission).
action_taken: Kept as its own unit_id. Transmission/substation trends for Java should combine p3b_jawa_bali (2014–15) with the uit_* rows (2016+).

issue: 'Dist. of West Java & Banten' was one unit until 2015 and was split into UID Jawa Barat and UID Banten from 2016.
action_taken: Kept as its own unit_id. Sum uid_jawa_barat + uid_banten for a continuous series.

issue: Reported as 'Dist. of Jakarta Raya & Tangerang' until 2017.
action_taken: Mapped to uid_jakarta_raya. Note that its service area included Tangerang in those years.

issue: The 2022 report has no Indonesia (national) row in the energy balance. Both pages end at the Java subtotal.
action_taken: Derived: GWh columns = Luar Jawa + Jawa, and % columns use PLN's own formulas (e.g. losses ÷ net production). The same method reproduces the published Indonesia row exactly for 2020, 2021 and 2023–2025. The row has derived = True.

issue: Definition change: from 2023 the Jawa (and therefore Indonesia) peak load is the sum of all Java units' peaks (about 40 GW), against about 24–27 GW in 2018–2022. National peak load jumps from 41.8 GW (2022) to 58.3 GW (2023) for this reason.
action_taken: Kept as published. For a consistent trend use the Luar Jawa row or the UIP2B (Java-Bali system) row, or footnote the 2023 break.

issue: Scope change: substation transformers of UIP3B Kalimantan and Sulawesi (about 13400 MVA) appear only in the 2023 and 2024 reports. They are absent before 2023 and in 2025.
action_taken: Kept as published. For a comparable national series, exclude these two units' rows.

issue: The 2018 household estimates are lower than in later years: Java has more PLN household customers than households, so its ratio is capped at 100%. PLN revised the household base from 2019, and the national ratio falls from 97.05% (2018) to 95.75% (2019).
action_taken: Kept as published. Treat 2018 electrification ratio as not comparable with later years.

issue: Mini and micro hydro are not reported separately before 2021, so they are included in hydro.
action_taken: mini_hydro and micro_hydro columns are empty for 2018–2020.

issue: 2018 Table 21 reports diesel including gas engines ('Total Diesel Including Diesel Gas'), and has no gas-engine column.
action_taken: gas_engine_mw is empty for 2018. Compare diesel + gas engine across years.

issue: The 2018 energy balance has no separate project or leased columns.
action_taken: Columns left empty for 2018.

issue: Source PDF error: the Papua and West Papua province rows' leased values (643.35 and 35.98) don't match their own subtotals, and the West Papua total (847.91) doesn't equal subtotal + purchased (724.11). The regional UIW Papua row is consistent.
action_taken: Kept as published. Use the UIW Papua dan Papua Barat row.

issue: Rounding: the voltage columns sum to 1 MVA less than the published total.
action_taken: Kept as published.

issue: Source inconsistency: the published Indonesia net production (269022.39) is 871 GWh higher than Luar Jawa + Jawa (268151.14).
action_taken: Kept as published.

issue: Source PDF error: the Generation Project row prints 140.84 MW under both diesel and gas engine. The components sum to 358.68 MW, but the published subtotal is 217.84 MW, so one of the two values is a duplicate.
action_taken: Kept as published. Use pln_owned_subtotal_mw / total_mw for this row.

issue: Source PDF error: subtotal + leased + IPP = 2856.52 MW, but the published total is 2946.52 MW (a 90 MW difference). Table 1 shows the same 2946.52.
action_taken: Kept as published.

issue: The Generation Project component rows are labelled differently in Table 1 and Table 21 (e.g. 2020: 'UIP Eastern Part of Kalimantan' in T1 vs 'UIP Western Part of Kalimantan' in T21). The Generation Project totals agree.
action_taken: Kept as labelled in each table.

issue: The source prints '3.00.00', a typo for 3.00 (the row's subtotal and total are 3.00).
action_taken: Read as 3.00.

issue: Source print error: diesel is printed as '60' and the subtotal as '6-'. The two province rows give 16.18 + 43.82 = 60.00.

issue: Some 2018 rows use a font whose characters are shifted (e.g. '*HQHUDWLRQ' = 'Generation').
action_taken: Decoded automatically. The original text is in unit_name_reported.

issue: Units are named in English and named differently over time (e.g. 'Region of Aceh', 'UIW Aceh', 'UID Aceh').
action_taken: Mapped to one canonical unit_id per service area (see units.csv). Distribution regions use the 2025 UID/UIW names. The name as printed is kept in unit_name_reported.

issue: Rows listed between the Java subtotal and Indonesia (e.g. UIW Papua, UIP construction units) are components of the Generation Project row, not the regional units themselves.
action_taken: Tagged row_type = project_component, with unit_id prefixed 'proj_' and parent proyek_pembangkitan. Don't add them to the regional units.

issue: Source PDF error: 70 kV (196.30) + 150 kV (175.05) = 371.35, which does not equal the published total (316.08). The province rows give 70 kV 231.18 and 150 kV 84.90, which do add up to 316.08.
action_taken: Kept as published. Use the province rows or the total_kms value.

issue: Source PDF error: 70 kV (204.18) + 150 kV (84.90) = 289.08, which does not equal the published total (371.35). The province rows give 70 kV 239.64 and 150 kV 131.71, which do add up to 371.35.
action_taken: Kept as published. Use the province rows or the total_kms value.

action_taken: Kept as published.

action_taken: No action needed.

issue: Scope inconsistency: only the 2024 report lists UIP3B Kalimantan (8747.62 kms) and UIP3B Sulawesi (8305.69 kms) transmission rows. Those lines are already counted under the Kalimantan/Sulawesi UIDs, so the published Indonesia total (90169.22) is about 17000 kms higher than in 2023 (70933) and 2025 (74973).

issue: Scope change: substation transformers for UIP3B Kalimantan and UIP3B Sulawesi (about 13480 MVA in 2024) are reported in 2023 and 2024 but are empty in the 2025 report. The 2025 Luar Jawa/Indonesia MVA totals therefore drop by about 13000 MVA.
action_taken: Kept as published. Compare years without these two units, or footnote the 2025 drop on the dashboard.
